Axiom:
**Directive prose (axioms, halt names, step procedures, contract identifiers, structural section headings) — English.** **Operator-facing artifact prose and operator-facing messages — Russian.** Russian applies to: - Portal body text inside `specs/README.md` (Vision, Scope descriptions in the table, Notes). - Minimal infra-base spec body (Vision sentence, table cell content beyond identifiers). - Halt messages emitted to the operator. - Phase Progress free-text fields.
English regardless of context: file paths, axiom IDs (`AX_*`), Trace anchors (`SU_R`), status tokens, scope-type tokens, section identifiers (`Vision`), Mermaid graph IDs.
